articles.content: In a significant move for India's market, Sebi has greenlit IPOs for Carlsberg's local entity, TMC Transformers, Ujin Pharma, and Matangi Rubber. Matangi Rubber has also successfully navigated the IPO approval process.

articles.title: Global Markets | Japan's Nikkei retreats from 6-week high as investors lock in gains
articles.content: The Nikkei 225 index in Japan faced a downturn as investors engaged in profit-taking, displaying caution in the wake of earlier gains. Nevertheless, analysts remain optimistic about Japanese stocks, bolstered by positive feedback from the Bank of Japan's tankan survey.

articles.title: US Treasury yield hits the highest since 2002 at 5.34%

Investors are now bracing for potentially further interest rate hikes from central banks.

articles.title: Rupee sinks to 96.31, logs biggest fall in over 2 months
articles.content: The Indian rupee has markedly dipped against the US dollar, hitting 96.3150. In tandem, the dollar index has surged to 101.9, exacerbating the rupee's depreciation and reflecting ongoing currency exchange volatility.

A substantial bond issuance is on the horizon, adding complexity to the supply-demand landscape.

Even though the Bank of Japan raised rates recently, inflation in Tokyo is rising, fueling predictions of additional rate hikes.
